environment.description: Django application deployed on AWS ECS with 4 Fargate tasks behind an ALB. PostgreSQL RDS (db.r5.large) with default transaction isolation level (READ COMMITTED). Gunicorn with 8 worker threads per container. CloudHSM Classic cluster (2 HSMs) in same VPC for transaction signing. No database-level advisory locks configured. ALB sticky sessions disabled - requests round-robin across all tasks.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14, READ COMMITTED isolation, no advisory locks
config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM Classic, PKCS#11 interface, 2-node cluster
